text: Northwind Analytics pricing for 2026: the Starter plan costs $49 per month, the Growth plan costs $99 per month, and the Pro plan costs $199 per month. All plans include unlimited dashboards and email support.
Northwind Analytics offers real-time dashboards, scheduled email reports, and CSV export. The Growth and Pro plans add Slack alerts and a public API with 1,000 requests per day.
Northwind Analytics launched its public API in June 2025. The API supports 1,000 requests per day on Growth and Pro plans.
Northwind Analytics customers include Beta Ltd, a retail chain with 40 stores, and Meridian Health, a clinic network with 12 locations. Beta Ltd uses Northwind for weekly sales reporting.
In the first quarter of 2026, Northwind Analytics reported $420,000 in revenue from 850 paying customers, with the Pro plan accounting for 45% of revenue.
Northwind Analytics support hours are Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm Pacific Time. Pro customers get priority support with a 4-hour response time.
Northwind Analytics pricing for 2024: the Starter plan costs $29 per month and the Growth plan costs $59 per month.
Northwind Analytics stores all customer data in the United States and is SOC 2 Type II certified as of February 2026. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
